_doc: What the build solver may put on gear at each wealth tier (goal.wealth). A line or unique is allowed when its tier is at or below the goal's. Sources are PoolMod::source / Fam::source values. Unique prices come from the app (live poe.ninja) or engine-data/wealth_prices.json; a unique with no price is not on the market (legacy, race, drop-disabled) and counts as unpriced.
_unveilCap: Most veiled (Jun unveil) mods a build holds across all its items: each is a gamble at the bench, so a mid-league player has a couple, not one per slot.
_poolFloor: Life (unreserved; plus energy shield for an energy shield build) the solver demands when the goal leaves the floor unset: what a player at this tier has (mid league 4.5k).
_madeToOrder: Watcher's Eye, Forbidden Flame/Flesh, Impossible Escape, Megalomaniac: the solver picks their mods, and a copy with chosen mods costs far more than the cheapest listing, so they start at this tier.
_madeToOrderDivines: What a copy of those uniques with the mods the solver chose costs, by the number of chosen mods (a jewel with 1 wanted notable, a Watcher's Eye with 2 or 3 wanted lines, Megalomaniac with 3 notables). Charged when above the cheapest listing. Estimates, not poe.ninja prices (it lists only the cheapest, random roll); no variant prices exist for these.
_budget: Whole build, in divine orbs: uniques at their price plus the rare estimate below. A tier with no entry (mirror) has no cap. The solver never takes gear over it.
_links: The main skill's links (its group size) bought on the crafting bench, in Orbs of Fusing (bench recipe: 5 links 150, 6 links 1500; mobalytics.gg/poe/guides/6-link-early-game-methods, altarofgaming.com/path-of-exile-six-link-item), priced at the snapshot's Orb of Fusing. Awakened and exceptional gems cost their snapshot price; other gems are levelled by the player.
_sockets: Sockets on the items that hold the build's gems: an item with 5 or 6 sockets in use costs Jeweller's Orbs (crafting bench: 5 sockets 70, 6 sockets 350; poedb.tw/Crafting_Bench), and colours cost Chromatic Orbs, the expected number of rerolls to get the colours the gems need given the base's Str/Dex/Int requirements (socket colour is weighted by those requirements; poedb.tw/Item_socket), at most chromaticCap (the bench's 4 non-white sockets cost 75). Priced at the snapshot's Chromatic and Jeweller's Orb.
_rare: Rare estimate: each affix line costs tierDivines[tier-1] (last entry for lower tiers), the sum of the lines times lineFactor for every good line (tier <= goodTier) past the first (fitted to live trade listings), times rareScale of the wealth tier (the live fit is at 468 chaos per divine; a tier scales it by the ratio of that to its own era: league start 110.6 on day 3 = 4.2, mid league about 360 = 1.3); a weapon's lines use weaponTierDivines (the armour table times 0.89, so the median model/listing ratio over 370 weapon listings is 1); eldritch implicits at eldritchDivines[tier-1] (mean listing price over its explicit lines, 46 one-implicit listings; tiers 1-4 and 5-6 pooled: the top tiers hardly list), each corrupted implicit and each unveiled mod (also net of their control items; all three scale with rareScale like the lines), the multimod (2 divine bench cost, maxroll metacrafting), other bench crafts, a catalyst and an anoint add flat. Magic items (flasks) cost magicDivines. Good ordinary lines (life, resist, attribute, tier <= goodTier) step down first when a craft is over budget. A craft over the build budget steps its lines down to the next tiers of the mod data (at most 3 down) until it fits. An unveiled mod costs unveilAttemptDivines / unveilHitChance (the market price of an item holding one, not the bench gamble), times goodFactor for every veiled line past the first on the item.
